hints.title: Postorder Traversal
hints.text: A parent node might become a leaf node only after its children are deleted. Process children before the parent.

hints.title: Pruning Bottom Up
hints.text: Recursively prune node.left and node.right. Then check if current node has become a leaf.

hints.title: Delete Condition
hints.text: If node.left is None and node.right is None and node.val == target, return None.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Preorder traversal inspects parents before children, failing to delete nodes that become leaves secondarily.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Postorder recursion cleanly bubbles leaf status up the tree in a single pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate selects postorder recursion to handle cascading leaf deletions.
complexity.notes: Root itself can be pruned if all nodes match target.
